generateField.systemRole: You are a top-tier web novel editor and bestselling author with ten years of experience, specializing in precisely designing core novel configurations.
generateField.promptCoreOutline:
Please generate a【Core Outline】for this novel.
Requirements: at least 150 words, include the protagonist's fatal crisis/opening dilemma, core objectives to complete, ultimate crisis, and major ups and downs.
The outline should have strong dramatic tension and commercial appeal.
generateField.promptWorldSetting:
Please generate a【World Setting/Initial Setup】for this novel.
Requirements: describe the background, era, power system, and social structure.
Include: physical dimension characteristics, power structures and fractures, core resource competition mechanisms.
All settings must inherently drive plot development.
generateField.promptGoldenFinger:
Please generate a【Golden Finger / Core Selling Point System】for this novel.
Requirements: describe the protagonist's differentiating advantages in detail.
Include: acquisition method, specific functions and core mechanisms, advancement growth path, side effects/limitations/costs.
The golden finger must create interesting interactions with worldbuilding rules.
generateField.promptProtagonistProfile:
Please generate a【Protagonist Profile】for this novel.
Requirements: include surface persona labels vs true personality, highly contrasting character flaws.
Core motivation needs to distinguish material goals (overt) from deep soul desires (covert).
The protagonist must have clear growth arc start and end points.
generateField.promptGlobalGuidance:
Please generate【Global Writing Requirements】for this novel.
Requirements: calculate strictly based on the actual scale of {{chapters}} chapters.
Include: front/middle/late portions in chapter counts, small/medium/large climax frequency.
Specify writing style requirements, core taboos/poison points, pacing control strategy.
generateField.promptWritingStyle:
Please design a【Writing Style Guide】for this novel.
Requirements: at least 100 words. This guide will direct AI writing and revision style adherence.
Please provide specific, actionable style requirements across these dimensions:
1. Narrative pace: overall tempo preference, scene switching frequency, paragraph length
2. Description density: environment/action/psychology description weight
3. Dialogue style: dialogue ratio, colloquialism level, dialect usage
4. Word choice: classical/modern/technical term tendency
5. Emotional tone: hot-blooded/dry/witty/heavy/lighthearted
6. Signature techniques: recommended rhetoric, transition techniques
Please recommend the best matching writing style based on this novel's genre ({{genre}}) and audience ({{audience}}).

workflowDefs.guideKishotenketsu:
【Kishotenketsu · 4-Part Structure】(Organize outline strictly by these four parts)
Suggested chapter distribution: {{total}} chapters total
Ki (approx. Ch.1~Ch.{{ch25}}, ~25% of total): Introduce world, characters, and daily life, establish reader empathy
Shō (approx. Ch.{{ch25Next}}~Ch.{{ch50}}, ~25%): Continue and deepen, show character relationships and conflict seeds
Ten (approx. Ch.{{ch50Next}}~Ch.{{ch75}}, ~25%): Core twist, unexpected change breaks existing order
Ketsu (approx. Ch.{{ch75Next}}~Ch.{{total}}, ~25%): Gather all threads, reveal theme, deliver ending
workflowDefs.guideMultiThread:
【Multi-thread Narrative】(Organize outline with multiple parallel storylines)
Suggested chapter distribution: {{total}} chapters total
Define these elements:
1. Number of threads: Set 2-4 independent yet interwoven storylines, each with its own protagonist or POV
2. Intersection points: Each thread converges around Ch.{{ch25}}, Ch.{{ch50}}, Ch.{{ch75}}
3. Pacing: Alternate between threads to avoid any single thread disappearing for too long
4. Final convergence: Around Ch.{{ch75}} all threads begin converging toward a unified climax
workflowDefs.guideFreeform:
【Free Structure】(No fixed narrative framework; arrange naturally based on story content)
Total: {{total}} chapters.
Design the most suitable narrative pace based on story type and content.
Core principles:
1. Ensure a minor climax or suspense release every 10-20 chapters
2. Clear opening setup (first 10-15%) and closing (last 10-15%)
3. Avoid monotonous pacing in the middle; arrange turning points
4. Flashbacks, non-linear, and fragmentary narration are all acceptable
workflowDefs.guideThreeAct:
【Three-Act Structure】(Organize outline strictly by this structure)
Suggested chapter distribution: {{total}} chapters total
Act I: Setup (approx. Ch.1~Ch.{{ch20}}, ~20% of total)
Act II: Confrontation & Development (approx. Ch.{{ch20Next}}~Ch.{{ch75}}, ~55%)
Act III: Climax & Resolution (approx. Ch.{{ch75Next}}~Ch.{{total}}, ~25%)
